articles.title: U.S. senators urge Treasury not to leave states out of GENIUS Act stablecoin process
articles.snippet: Senators led by Republican Cynthia Lummis are insisting the Treasury Department ensure states get a process to prove their ability to supervise stablecoins.

articles.title: BlackRock's new bitcoin ETF lets institutions earn from volatility. There's a catch.
US government watchdog urges FDIC to coordinate on crypto oversight
articles.snippet: The US Government Accountability Office says that regulators, including the FDIC, lack an “ongoing coordination mechanism for addressing blockchain risks.”

articles.title: US Government Orders Anthropic to Pull Claude Fable, Mythos AI Models
articles.snippet: Anthropic pushed back against what it described as an overreach, saying the vulnerability cited is already widespread across the industry.
